body: Rule (rules-riding): get off at the stable, the horse walks into its stall; leave the game while riding, it walks back alone.

comments.text:
Done: after you get off, the horse walks back to its stall.
Leftover: it stops at the gate (the stable model has no opening).

short: Horse walks to its stall alone. OK?

title: Horse goes to its stall
